mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the last two months signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) both increase by more than 2% in the last month, it signals a strengthening demand environment, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint correlation between HOUST, RSAFS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the last month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity slows.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decrease > 100k and UNRATE increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint correlation between PAYEMS decrease, UNRATE increase and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy to combat inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) is positive but below 2% for two consecutive quarters, it signals a moderate demand environment, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy is growing, but not at a pace that would trigger aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 moderate growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
